CENTRAL=('Q-001','Q-002','Q-003')

    m=re.search(r'-(\d{8})-',i); return m.group(1) if m else '00000000'

mats,evals,hyps=data['materials'],data['evaluations'],data['hypotheses']
def pq(h): return h.get('primary_question_id') or (h.get('question_ids') or [''])[0]
def pm(st,q): return {i['hypothesis_id']:float(i.get('posterior',0.0)) for i in st['questions'][q]['hypotheses']}
def collect(mode):
    # mode='primary': 1c01aa-faithful (pq in central, script rows excluded), row-level
    # mode='multi': qids intersect central, script rows counted as third class, pair-level LOO
    sup={'reacq':[],'flagonly':[],'script':[]}
    for eid,ev in evals.items():
        if ev.get('verdict')!='supports': continue
        h=hyps.get(ev.get('target_hypothesis_id'))
        if not h: continue
        if mode=='primary':
            if pq(h) not in CENTRAL: continue
            if ev.get('evidence_type')=='reproducible_script' and (ev.get('script_command') or '').strip(): continue
        else:
            if not (set(h.get('question_ids') or [])&set(CENTRAL)): continue

        if c=='script_verified': sup['script'].append(eid)
        elif c=='all_verified': sup['reacq'].append(eid)
        elif c in ('zero_verified','no_materials','mixed_verified'): sup['flagonly'].append(eid)
    return sup
def mwu(a,b):
    n1,n2=len(a),len(b)
    pairs=sorted([(v,0) for v in a]+[(v,1) for v in b])
    ranks=[0.0]*(n1+n2); i=0
    while i<len(pairs):
        j=i
        while j+1<len(pairs) and pairs[j+1][0]==pairs[i][0]: j+=1
        avg=(i+j)/2+1
        for k in range(i,j+1): ranks[k]=avg
        i=j+1
    R1=sum(r for r,(v,g) in zip(ranks,pairs) if g==0)
    U1=R1-n1*(n1+1)/2
    mu=n1*n2/2; N=n1+n2
    T=sum(t**3-t for t in Counter(v for v,_ in pairs).values())
    var=n1*n2/12.0*((N+1)-T/(N*(N-1))) if N>1 else 0.0
    sd=math.sqrt(var) if var>0 else 0.0
    z=(U1-mu)/sd if sd else 0.0
    p=2*(1-0.5*(1+math.erf(abs(z)/math.sqrt(2))))

def mean(x): return sum(x)/len(x) if x else float('nan')
def loo(sup,pair_level):
    out={}
    for gated,lab in ((False,'P_t'),(True,'P_gate')):
        B=bs.compute_belief_state(data=data,receiver_gated=gated)
        Bm={q:pm(B,q) for q in B['questions']}
        for cls in ('reacq','flagonly'):
            ds=[]
            for eid in sup[cls]:
                row=data['evaluations'].pop(eid)
                st=bs.compute_belief_state(data=data,receiver_gated=gated)
                data['evaluations'][eid]=row
                h=hyps[row['target_hypothesis_id']]; hid=h['hypothesis_id']

                for q in qs:
                    ds.append(Bm[q].get(hid,0.0)-pm(st,q).get(hid,0.0))
            out[(lab,cls)]=ds
    return out
def report(tag,sup,pair_level):
    print('%s composition(rows) reacq=%d flagonly=%d script=%d'%(tag,len(sup['reacq']),len(sup['flagonly']),len(sup['script'])))
    res=loo(sup,pair_level)
    for lab in ('P_t','P_gate'):
        a=res[(lab,'reacq')]; b=res[(lab,'flagonly')]
        print('%s %s reacq n=%d mean=%.12g max=%.12g'%(tag,lab,len(a),mean(a),max(a)))
        print('%s %s flagonly n=%d mean=%.12g max=%.12g'%(tag,lab,len(b),mean(b),max(b)))

        U,z,p=mwu(a,b)
        print('%s %s MWU U_reacq=%s z=%.3f p=%.5f'%(tag,lab,U,z,p))
